title: record_queue_change_denied reads as a move when the refused write is a create into a queue
body:
domain:server#2 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufziCTpjnYbdh76SAWwb

Origin: nit 3 of the contract review on PR #32338 (card #32278).

The catalog sentence `errors.record_queue_change_denied` in `packages/spec/src/system/operation-message.ts` ends "if it needs to be moved" in all four locales. `denyQueueWrite` in `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin-authz-middleware.ts` also throws it for a create into a queue the caller is not a member of. Nothing is being moved in that case, so the sentence reads slightly wrong.

Premise re-check: `git grep -n "record_queue_change_denied" -- packages/` lists both the catalog entry and the two `denyQueueWrite` sites.

Wanted: one sentence that fits both the create and the update, or a separate create key on the insert site (the one-wire-code, several-keys rule from #7451). Status, `code`, `message` and `details` must not move.

Clause-②: no (copy only; the key is not removed)
